AccessTierEnum.description: The access tier of a source's data.
AccessTierEnum.title: AccessTierEnum

CirroExecutorEnum.description: How Cirro executes a process: the values of Executor in the Cirro Data API (https://app.cirro.bio/openapi/cirro-data-latest.yml).
CirroExecutorEnum.title: CirroExecutorEnum

Condition.description: A test on an item in a state. Each slot that is set must match (and); within a slot, any listed value matches (or). An empty condition matches everything.

anyProperties.description: Data property ids; the item has at least one.

classes.description: Data class names from the pinned release. A class matches its subclasses too.

fileSetClasses.description: File set class names (additionalType of the file set the file belongs to).

noProperties.description: Data property ids; the item has none of them.

sourceFacts.description: Tests on the source's register entry; all must hold.

standards.description: Standard ids from this rule set.

techniques.description: measurementTechnique values; the file declares at least one.

Condition.title: Condition

DataProperty.description: A property of an item of data that rules test and workflows can set or clear, such as "dates" or "free_text". Its initial value is true if any of its sources says so; a property with no sources starts false and only workflows set it.

derivedFrom.description: Sources of the property; any one makes it true.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

DataProperty.title: DataProperty

DatePolicyEnum.description: DRAFT. How dates from a source are masked at release.
DatePolicyEnum.title: DatePolicyEnum

DeidentificationClassEnum.description: DRAFT. How a source's data was de-identified before deposit.
DeidentificationClassEnum.title: DeidentificationClassEnum

FileLocation.description: Where a file's current data is, and the Cirro dataset that holds it, if any.

file.description: The @id of a data file in the sidecar.

location.description: A storage location (URL or URL template).

FileLocation.title: FileLocation

FileResult.description: What a step reported for one input file: where its output is (for a Cirro step, the output dataset and its location), and which data properties the output still has, if the step checked. Reported properties replace the predicted ones.

file.description: The @id of a data file in the sidecar.

location.description: A storage location (URL or URL template).

properties.description: Data property ids the output has.

FileResult.title: FileResult

InteractionRule.description: The workflow that carries out a batch-level interaction (withdraw, restrict). It must cover every zone that any item can reach.
InteractionRule.title: InteractionRule

ModuleEnum.description: The platform modules of the RDDC infrastructure that hold data.
ModuleEnum.title: ModuleEnum

Obligation.description: A duty: an item matching the condition must pass through a workflow of the required kind before it enters one of the zones, or before one of the workflows runs on it. A required-kind workflow discharges the duty only if its output no longer matches the condition.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

requiredKind.description: The kind of workflow that discharges the duty.

when.description: The condition the rule applies to, tested on the item.

Obligation.title: Obligation

Parameter.description: A parameter passed to a workflow. Its value is a literal, a field of the sidecar, or a field of the source register, resolved when the step is dispatched. A literal can contain {sourceId}, {batchId} and {dispatchId}, filled in at dispatch.

fromSidecar.description: A sidecar field: "batch.<field>" for the sidecar header, or "fileSet.<field>" for the file set the group belongs to.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

Parameter.title: Parameter

Plan.description: The orchestrator's view of one batch: groups of files, each with the steps that ran and the steps still to run, and any batch-level steps. scripts/orchestrate.py writes it; the dispatcher runs the ready steps and records their status and results in it; the next call reads it back as the batch state.

batchSteps.description: Steps that act on the batch as a whole, such as a withdrawal.

groups.description: Groups of files with their steps.

modelRelease.description: The model release whose classes, flags, fields and enum values the rules name.

problems.description: Why the batch or group is blocked or stopped.

registerVersion.description: The version of the source register.

sidecarConformsTo.description: The sidecar version URI the plan was derived from.

status.description: Where the batch or step stands.

Plan.title: Plan

PlanGroup.description: Files that take the same route: members of one file set (or files outside any file set) with the same steps so far and the same steps to come.

fileSet.description: The @id of the file set the files belong to, if any.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

problems.description: Why the batch or group is blocked or stopped.

steps.description: Steps that ran, then steps to run, in order.

PlanGroup.title: PlanGroup

PlanStep.description: One workflow run on the group's files. A ready step carries everything needed to dispatch it.

cirroEnvironment.description: A Cirro environment ID. The Cirro Data API calls an environment a project, so this is the projectId in its paths, e.g. POST /projects/{projectId}/execution.

dispatchId.description: Identifies one run of a step. Kept across calls.

inputs.description: Where each input file's current data is.

outputLocation.description: Where a container or service step writes its output. A Cirro step's output location is its new dataset's.

pipeline.description: For a container, the image; for a service, the endpoint.

pipelineVersion.description: The workflow version the rules were written against.

results.description: What the step reported for each file (filled in by the dispatcher).

sourceDatasets.description: The Cirro datasets a Cirro analysis reads (sourceDatasetIds): those of its inputs.

status.description: Where the batch or step stands.

PlanStep.title: PlanStep

Prohibition.description: An item matching the condition never enters any of the zones.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

when.description: The condition the rule applies to, tested on the item.

zones.description: Zone ids the item never enters.

Prohibition.title: Prohibition

PropertySource.description: One way a data property can be true at deposit.

anyOf.description: For register: the values that make the property true.

classes.description: Data class names from the pinned release. A class matches its subclasses too.

key.description: The sensitivity flag (flag_true, flag_false), class annotation (annotation) or source register field (register) to read.

PropertySource.title: PropertySource

PropertySourceEnum.description: Where the value of a data property comes from.
PropertySourceEnum.title: PropertySourceEnum

RuleSet.description: The processing rules for one model release. A batch is processed under the rule set whose modelRelease matches the version in its sidecar's conformsTo.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

interactionRules.description: Workflows that carry out batch-level interactions.

modelRelease.description: The model release whose classes, flags, fields and enum values the rules name.

obligations.description: Duties that hold on every route.

standards.description: Standards the rules refer to, in priority order.

targets.description: Where each kind of item must end up.

version.description: The version of this rule set. Change it whenever the rules change.

RuleSet.title: RuleSet

RunnerEnum.description: How the orchestrator dispatches a workflow.
RunnerEnum.title: RunnerEnum

SourceFactTest.description: A test on a source register field. The field must have one of anyOf (if given) and none of noneOf. A missing field matches noneOf tests and no anyOf test, so "noneOf: [open]" also catches a source with no tier.

anyOf.description: Values, one of which must be present.

noneOf.description: Values that must not be present.

SourceFactTest.title: SourceFactTest

SourceRegister.description: DRAFT. The source register as the rules read it: one entry per source. The ACT keeps the register; a source's descriptor (SourceDescriptor) carries the subset its contributor needs.

registerVersion.description: The version of the source register.

SourceRegister.title: SourceRegister

SourceRegisterEntry.description: DRAFT. The register's facts about one source that processing rules can read.

accessTier.description: The access tier of the source's data.

contributorId.description: The contributor's identifier, as in sidecars.

datePolicy.description: How the source's dates are masked at release.

deidentificationClass.description: How the source's data was de-identified.

deliveryRole.description: The delivery role the source uploads with.

modalities.description: ModalityEnum values the source is registered for.

sourceId.description: The source's identifier, as in sidecars.

useTerms.description: The source's data use terms, as GA4GH DUO terms, e.g. DUO:0000042.

SourceRegisterEntry.title: SourceRegisterEntry

Standard.description: A standard an item can conform to, as the rules refer to it. An item's standard is the first rule set standard (in rule set order) whose URL is in its file set's conformsTo.

classes.description: Data classes that can conform to this standard.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

outputOnly.description: The standard is only produced by workflows, never declared in a sidecar, so it need not be a pinned conformsTo value, and no deposited file takes it.

url.description: The standard's URL as sidecars write it in conformsTo.

Standard.title: Standard

StepStatusEnum.description: Where a step of a batch stands. For a Cirro step, the dispatcher maps the output dataset's status: COMPLETED to succeeded; FAILED to failed; PENDING, STARTING, RUNNING and STOPPING to running.
StepStatusEnum.title: StepStatusEnum

Target.description: Where items matching a condition at deposit must end up. Each item gets the matching target with the lowest priority number; two matching targets with the same priority are a conflict. A target can be a deliberate terminal state, such as holding a file for a curator.

goalClasses.description: Data classes the item must end as (subclasses match). Unset: any.

goalNoProperties.description: Data property ids the item must not have at the end. Unset: any.

goalStandard.description: Standard id the item must end in. Unset: any.

goalZone.description: Zone id the item must end in.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

priority.description: Lower wins. For workflows, breaks ties between equally short routes.

when.description: The condition the rule applies to, tested on the item.

Target.title: Target

Workflow.description: An existing workflow the orchestrator can dispatch, described by what it consumes, produces and guarantees, not by how it works.

clears.description: Data property ids the output no longer has.

consumes.description: Items this workflow accepts. Required unless the kind is withdraw or restrict.

coversZones.description: Zone ids a withdraw or restrict workflow acts on.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

kind.description: What the workflow does, for obligations.

operation.description: What the workflow does, as an EDAM operation, e.g. EDAM:operation_3283 (Anonymisation).

pipeline.description: For a container, the image; for a service, the endpoint.

pipelineVersion.description: The workflow version the rules were written against.

priority.description: Lower wins. For workflows, breaks ties between equally short routes.

produces.description: The data class of the output. Unset: the same class as the input.

producesStandard.description: The standard id of the output. Unset: the same standard as the input.

readsFrom.description: Zones it reads input from. Required unless the kind is withdraw or restrict.

recordsTo.description: For a record workflow, the GOVERN register it writes to, e.g. "participants table".

sets.description: Data property ids the output has (after clears are applied).

writesTo.description: The zone it writes output to. Required unless the kind is withdraw or restrict.

Workflow.title: Workflow

WorkflowKindEnum.description: What a workflow does to the data, as far as the rules are concerned. Obligations name a kind that must run.
WorkflowKindEnum.title: WorkflowKindEnum

Zone.description: A place where data sits, such as the deposit prefix, the de-identification and QC environment, the normalized store or the release database.

cirroEnvironment.description: The Cirro environment that holds this zone's data. Only Cirro processes write to such a zone, and Cirro processes other than ingests read only from such zones.

id.description: A local identifier, unique within its list.

initial.description: Deposited files start in this zone. Exactly one zone is initial.

location.description: Where a container or service step writing to this zone puts its output: a template with {sourceId}, {batchId} and {dispatchId}. Not used for the initial zone, whose location is the sidecar's url, or for a Cirro environment zone, where Cirro chooses each dataset's location.

module.description: The platform module the zone belongs to. Unset: outside the platform, such as public content.

Zone.title: Zone

description: The orchestrator's view of one batch: groups of files, each with the steps that ran and the steps still to run, and any batch-level steps. scripts/orchestrate.py writes it; the dispatcher runs the ready steps and records their status and results in it; the next call reads it back as the batch state.

batchSteps.description: Steps that act on the batch as a whole, such as a withdrawal.

groups.description: Groups of files with their steps.

modelRelease.description: The model release whose classes, flags, fields and enum values the rules name.

problems.description: Why the batch or group is blocked or stopped.

registerVersion.description: The version of the source register.

sidecarConformsTo.description: The sidecar version URI the plan was derived from.

status.description: Where the batch or step stands.

title: rddc-processing
